## What this changes

Name the file and section, and say what the change does in a sentence.

## Why

If this corrects an error, quote the passage as it currently reads and say what
is wrong with it. If this adds material, say what a reader can do with it that
they could not do before.

## Source

Cite the primary source for any substantive claim: title, publisher, date, URL
and access date. A change that rests on a consulting report, analyst note or
news article without a primary source will not be merged.

## Checklist

- [ ] Australian English
- [ ] No em dashes
- [ ] Plain Markdown, no HTML
- [ ] No code, GitHub Actions, badges, widgets or binary files
- [ ] No client material, real organisation detail, or anything traceable to a
      real engagement
- [ ] No text reproduced from Australia's Guidance for AI Adoption, the NIST AI
      RMF or another referenced work; linked instead
- [ ] Any idea taken from another author is attributed in `REFERENCES.md`, with
      the change made stated in place
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated in this same change
- [ ] If a diagram is added or changed: it shows something the adjacent text
      cannot, states no rule the text does not state, drops no condition the
      text states, and is fully redundant with the text for a reader who cannot
      see it
